tagline: Cairo's finest selection of luxury & sports cars
address: 151 El Sayed El Merghany, Almazah, Heliopolis, Cairo
aboutParagraphs: One of One Automotive is a Heliopolis showroom built around a small, hand-picked selection of luxury and sports cars, carrying marques such as Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Range Rover, BMW and Audi alongside a rotating cast of others. Every car earns its spot on the floor through condition, specification and character rather than simply being in stock, so the collection stays tight rather than sprawling.

The showroom sits at 151 El Sayed El Merghany in Almazah, Heliopolis, and is open daily, giving visitors room to walk the floor and look closely at a car before deciding anything. Reaching the team is straightforward too, with three phone lines and an active Instagram and Facebook presence for anyone who wants a look at the collection before making the trip.

Once a car is chosen, delivery is immediate rather than something to wait weeks for, and the finance side is handled with flexible instalment options worked out around the buyer. The dealership also welcomes trade-ins, valuing a visitor's current car honestly and setting it against whatever comes next, so the whole process from walk-around to handover stays in one place.
heroText: A tightly curated Heliopolis showroom of hand-picked luxury and sports cars, with immediate delivery and flexible finance on every one of them.

address: New Damietta: Sohbagiya Street, next to Cedar Cafe; Cairo: Nasr City, Tenth District, Shinzo Abe Axis
aboutParagraphs: El Basma Motors is a showroom for used SUVs, bringing in established marques including Volkswagen, Toyota, Kia, Skoda and Hyundai. Models on the floor include the Volkswagen Tiguan, Toyota Fortuner, Kia Sportage, Skoda Kodiaq and Hyundai Tucson, giving visitors a straightforward line of mid-size and family SUVs to compare in one place.

The dealership runs two branches: one in New Damietta on the Delta coast, on Sohbagiya Street next to Cedar Cafe, and another in Nasr City, Cairo, on the Tenth District's Shinzo Abe Axis. Having a foothold in both the Delta and the capital means a buyer in either region has a branch within reach.

Each SUV that comes through the showroom is photographed from multiple angles, exterior, rear and dashboard, so a visitor gets a clear look at a car's condition and interior before ever stepping onto the floor. The team can be reached through either branch's phone lines or through Instagram and Facebook, where the current lineup is kept up to date.
heroText: Two branches, in New Damietta and Nasr City, carrying a straightforward lineup of used SUVs from Volkswagen, Toyota, Kia, Skoda and Hyundai.

address: 7 Shahid Mohamed Abdel Moneim St, off Nabil El Wakkad, Ard El Golf, Nasr City, Cairo
aboutParagraphs: Golf Star Motors is an authorised distributor in Nasr City, working across buying, selling and financing for a wide range of major makes, so a visitor can handle the whole exchange, trade-in included, without shuttling between separate showrooms.

The showroom is at 7 Shahid Mohamed Abdel Moneim Street, off Nabil El Wakkad in Ard El Golf, Nasr City, and stands as one of the longest-standing car houses in the neighbourhood, buying, selling and financing across every major make under one roof.

The finance side is kept deliberately simple: instalment plans are sized around a buyer's income, arranged without a bank credit inquiry, hidden insurance requirement or additional fees buried in the paperwork, and government employees, doctors, university professors, business owners and homemakers are offered their own terms.
heroText: One of the longest-standing car houses in Nasr City, offering straightforward instalment plans across a wide range of major makes without a credit inquiry or hidden fees.

tagline: Authorised distributor for the world's major makes
address: 13 Ramu Buildings, Omar Ibn El Khattab, Nasr City, Cairo 11786
aboutParagraphs: Al Ahmady Motors is an authorised distributor for a range of major makes in Egypt, including Chery, MG, Citroën, Opel and Forthing, working across sales, instalments and after-sales service under one roof.

The dealership operates across Fifth Settlement, Sheraton, Nasr City and Heliopolis, with its head office at 13 Ramu Buildings on Omar Ibn El Khattab Street in Nasr City, so a buyer in several parts of Cairo has a branch within reach.

The relationship continues after the sale: genuine maintenance and spare parts keep a car the way it was delivered, and the dealership can be reached through its hotline or by WhatsApp for anyone who wants a question answered before visiting.
heroText: Four Cairo branches back one authorised distributor, with maintenance and parts support that carries on well after the sale.

address: Maadi · Manial · Nasr City, Cairo
aboutParagraphs: El Emam Motors is an authorised dealer for more than fifteen makes, including MG, Chery, Nissan, Opel and Kaiyi, giving visitors a wide spread of models to choose from without having to check multiple showrooms.
With branches in Maadi, Manial and Nasr City, the dealership puts a showroom within reach across several parts of Cairo, so seeing a car in person rarely means a long trip.
The deposit and the instalment are set out from the start, and a buyer chooses the pairing that suits their income before anything is signed, so nothing changes once the paperwork is done.
heroText: An authorised dealer for more than fifteen makes across three Cairo branches, with the deposit and instalment laid out plainly before anything is signed.

tagline: Two move the body, four move the soul
address: 46 El-Thawra Street, Heliopolis, Cairo
aboutParagraphs: Wheels Automotive keeps a deliberately short list in Heliopolis, cars the team knows well rather than a long row with histories they don't. Marques on the floor have included Audi, Mercedes-Benz, Range Rover and BYD, chosen a handful at a time rather than stocked deep.

Every car is inspected by the team before it enters the hall, and each one carries a full spec card covering engine, output, rims, audio and everything fitted inside, so what's on the card is what actually stands in front of a visitor.
Handover happens in the Heliopolis hall itself, at 46 El-Thawra Street, rather than from a separate lock-up across town, so the car a buyer inspects is the one they drive away in.
heroText: A short, hand-inspected list of cars in the Heliopolis hall, each one carrying a full spec card so nothing about it is left to guesswork.

address: Maadi, Cairo
aboutParagraphs: Vision Auto is a new-car showroom in Maadi, keeping a single lit hall that carries Hyundai, Chery, Changan, Haval, Nissan and Fiat side by side, so visitors can compare several marques of brand-new cars under one roof rather than crossing the city.
The hall has a distinct identity: a rough stone wall lit from below, with cars standing against it by day and the forecourt taking over after dark when the sign lights up over the front row.
Cars are available for immediate delivery rather than on order, with flexible instalment plans and registration handled by the showroom, so a buyer can walk out with the paperwork largely settled.
heroText: A single Maadi showroom carrying six new-car marques side by side, with immediate delivery and registration handled in house.

address: Maxim Mall, Auto Hub & Museum (A204), New Cairo
aboutParagraphs: Khaled Aboud Automotive is a showroom for luxury and exotic cars, with marques on the floor including BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Range Rover, Hummer, Jeep and Exeed.

The collection is kept inside the Auto Hub & Museum in New Cairo, a glass and concrete hall with even light down both sides, dark columns and a floor that throws just enough reflection to set a car against, at unit A204 in Maxim Mall.

Each car is catalogued in detail rather than simply listed, with the factory name of its exterior colour recorded alongside the interior leather, veneer, engine and wheels, so a visitor knows exactly what they are looking at before they arrive.
heroText: A New Cairo collection of luxury and exotic marques, each car catalogued down to its factory paint name, interior leather and specification.

address: A1, Chillout Gardenia, Suez Road
aboutParagraphs: Phantom Auto is a new-energy vehicle dealership on the Suez road, east of Cairo, authorized to sell Rox, Zeekr, IM Motors, DFSK, Geely, Baic, Fiat and Arcfox. Beyond the authorized franchises, marques including BYD, Changan and DEEPAL are also available on the floor.
The showroom sits at A1, Chillout Gardenia, on the Suez road, giving it a straightforward footprint for anyone travelling out from New Cairo or further along the route.

Cars across the lineup are consistently photographed on the same stretch of road, against the same green verge and palms, giving the whole floor a unified look whether the car on show is a compact sedan or a full-size SUV.
heroText: An authorized new-energy dealer on the Suez road carrying eight franchised marques alongside additional brands like BYD, Changan and DEEPAL.

aboutParagraphs: ST4Matic is a reconditioned-car showroom dealing in petrol and electric cars, both zero-mileage and used. The fleet draws on German and Japanese marques, with BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Subaru among the cars that pass through the showroom floor.

The showroom is located on Fareed Semeika Street in El Nozha, Cairo, with three phone lines open for calls and an active Facebook page keeping the current fleet visible to anyone browsing before a visit.

Several cars on the floor carry ambient interior lighting as standard, with cluster and trim illumination that shifts between drive modes, a detail the showroom highlights across its BMW and Mercedes-Benz stock. Flexible financing is available on every car sold, keeping the buying process straightforward from first look to handover.
heroText: A reconditioned German and Japanese fleet, including BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Subaru, out of one showroom in El Nozha, with flexible financing on every car.
address: 86 Fareed Semeika St, Al Matar, El Nozha, Cairo

tagline: A luxurious car for your elegant personality
aboutParagraphs: A Class Automotive is an exotics gallery showing a rotating selection of high-end marques that has included Lamborghini, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Land Rover, Toyota, Genesis and Nissan. Each car that comes through the floor is presented as a single, carefully staged specimen rather than one of a crowded lineup.

The gallery is set at City Park in Sheikh Zayed City, and every car is photographed in the same room, against a pale stone wall carrying the dealership's name and crest, so the setting stays constant while the car on the floor changes. Visitors can reach the team on three phone lines or follow the gallery's Instagram for a look at what is currently on the floor.

Cars arriving on the floor are frequently low-mileage or brand new, including a Porsche Cayenne GTS that arrived with 1,800 kilometres on the clock and was still under the original dealer's warranty, giving buyers an added layer of confidence beyond the showroom presentation itself.
heroText: A dedicated exotics showroom in Sheikh Zayed, presenting a rotating floor of marques from Lamborghini to Land Rover against the gallery's own signature backdrop.
address: City Park, Sheikh Zayed City, Giza

tagline: Used cars, every model, on the lowest deposit
aboutParagraphs: Middle East Motors sells and finances used cars across a wide range of models, arranging bank finance so buyers can drive away without a large deposit up front. The floor draws from marques including Mercedes-Benz, Renault and Fiat, spanning family saloons, hatchbacks and crossovers.
The showroom is on Ahmed Mohamed Ali Street in Heliopolis, tucked off Abdel Hamid Badawi behind the KFC at Nadi El Shams, a landmark that makes the unit easy to find even without a formal storefront.

Listings are written using the vocabulary of the Egyptian used-car trade, terms like kasr zero and fabrika bel-kamel that describe a car's mileage and condition, and the team can be reached by phone or through the dealership's Instagram and Facebook pages for anything not covered in a listing.
heroText: Bank-financed used cars sold straight off the kerb in Heliopolis, with marques spanning Mercedes-Benz to Renault and Fiat on the floor.
address: 4 Ahmed Mohamed Ali St, off Abdel Hamid Badawi, behind KFC Nadi El Shams, Heliopolis

tagline: Experience more than 20 years in car dealership
aboutParagraphs: Bedawy Automotive is a long-established Cairo dealership carrying a broad roster of marques that spans established European names such as Škoda, Opel, SEAT, Fiat, Nissan and Hyundai alongside newer arrivals including MG, Chery, ROX and AVATR. The result is a floor that covers both familiar European stock and the newest Chinese entrants side by side.

The showroom is at Building 15 Ideal on Al-Nasr Road, Cairo, where every car is presented in the same indoor bay: a black room with a stone feature wall and the dealership's own gold crest mounted above the car.

Buyers can reach the showroom by phone or follow its Instagram page for a look at the current stock before visiting in person, with each car in the bay given the same careful presentation regardless of marque or origin.
heroText: Twelve marques under one roof, from established European names to the newest Chinese arrivals, each car presented in the dealership's own showroom bay.
address: Building 15 Ideal, Al-Nasr Road, Cairo

aboutParagraphs: Al Rowad Auto Group sells new cars sourced from five origins, Chinese, European, American, Korean and Spanish marques, covering names from BYD, Geely and Chery to Škoda, Renault, Mercedes-Benz, Jeep, KGM, Nissan, Subaru, SEAT and Cupra. Every car on the floor is available for immediate delivery rather than an ordered wait.

The group runs three branches: one on Maadi Autostrad Road at the lower entrance of Al-Meraj City inside the A1 station, one on the Shahid Axis Road in Nasr City, and a third at Al-Hassan Tower opposite the Fayoum Culture Palace, giving buyers a branch to visit in both Cairo and Fayoum.

Each branch runs its own bank of phone lines for calls and WhatsApp, and the dealership keeps its Instagram and Facebook pages updated with current stock, with directions to any of the three branches available through Maps.
heroText: Immediate delivery on new cars across three branches in Cairo and Fayoum, with marques spanning five origins from BYD and Geely to Renault, Mercedes-Benz and KGM.
address: Maadi Autostrad Road, lower entrance of Al-Meraj City, inside the A1 station; Showroom S5–S6, Shahid Axis Road, Nasr City; Al-Hassan Tower, opposite the Fayoum Culture Palace

aboutParagraphs: Auto Gate is a luxury automobile seller based in Egypt, carrying marques that include Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Land Rover and BMW. Their story highlights sort the floor by drivetrain as well as marque, with electric and hybrid categories alongside the petrol models actually documented there, such as the Dodge Challenger.

The dealership works from a single forecourt at 64 El-Nozha Street in Heliopolis, next to the Mobil station, with cars displayed outdoors under the dealership's own illuminated sign rather than inside a showroom hall.
Buyers can reach the team by phone or WhatsApp, or follow the dealership's Instagram and Facebook pages to see what is currently on the forecourt, with directions available through Maps.
heroText: A luxury automobile seller in Heliopolis carrying marques from Mercedes-Benz to Porsche, Land Rover and BMW, including electric and hybrid options.
address: 64 El-Nozha Street, Heliopolis, next to the Mobil station

aboutParagraphs: Auto Dynamics is a long-established Cairo dealership that curates a selection of world-class cars, with marques on the floor spanning Jaguar, Alfa Romeo, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Land Rover and Mazda alongside both new and pre-owned stock.

Every car in the collection is presented in the dealership's own showroom doorway, photographed the same way each time so a visitor can compare one car against the next on equal footing before making the trip to Cairo to see it in person.

Listings are unusually thorough for the trade: each one runs to a full specification sheet covering drivetrain, interior, technology, exterior and safety, with an exact odometer reading given for every pre-owned car, and the dealership's Instagram page is kept current with what's on the floor.
heroText: A long-established Cairo dealership curating world-class cars across marques including Jaguar, Porsche, Land Rover and Mercedes-Benz, with a full specification sheet published for every car.
address: Cairo, Egypt

aboutParagraphs: Zayed Auto is a small, owner-run dealership on a parade in Beverly Hills, Sheikh Zayed, where Eslam Zayed sells a handful of used cars directly off the pavement outside his shopfront. Recent stock has included a Mercedes-Benz C180 AMG, a MINI Cooper Countryman and a Hyundai Creta.

The shop sits next to a bank branch on the parade, with around half a dozen cars parked on the pavement outside and a hand-lettered sign marking the door. It is a compact, street-level operation rather than an indoor showroom, with every car visible to passersby before they step inside.

Buyers can reach Eslam directly by phone or WhatsApp, or follow the dealership on Instagram to see what is currently on the pavement. Listings are also unusually specific about condition: on one Hyundai Creta, the seller noted exactly which two body panels had been repainted rather than simply describing the whole car as factory-original.
heroText: One forecourt, one seller: every car at Zayed Auto is sold directly by Eslam Zayed rather than passed between salespeople.
address: Beverly Hills, Sheikh Zayed

aboutParagraphs: Mansy Automotive is a car showroom in Cairo carrying marques including Mercedes-Benz, MG and CUPRA, with cars on the floor including a Mercedes-Benz CLE 200, an MG GT, and two CUPRA models, the Leon and the Formentor. Every listing is built from hard figures alone: engine size, power, torque, transmission and drivetrain, rather than descriptive language.

Every car on the floor is photographed in the same showroom, in front of a gold fluted column that stands behind each one, and every interior shot includes the same red branded mat in the footwell. Outside, the cars sit under a plain white sign bearing the dealership's name in black capitals, with no strapline beneath it.

Buyers can reach the showroom by phone, through its Instagram and Facebook pages, or in person via the address on Maps. The consistency of the photography and the detail published for each car make it straightforward to compare one listing against another before a visit.
heroText: Mansy Automotive's floor spans everything from a Mercedes-Benz CLE to a CUPRA Formentor offered across three different powertrains, mild hybrid, turbo petrol and plug-in hybrid, each one listed by the numbers rather than a sales pitch.
address: Cairo, Egypt

aboutParagraphs: Motor Zone is a car dealership in Heliopolis selling new Chinese and European vehicles on finance. The dealership carries a mix of models, including SUVs and saloons, each offered with a stated deposit and monthly payment, along with the interest rate its financing plans start from.

The shop is on Sayed Zakaria Street in Sheraton, Heliopolis, next to Al-Siddiq Mosque in the Morabaa El-Wozara area. It is a straightforward storefront operation focused on new-vehicle sales rather than a large indoor showroom.

Buyers can reach the dealership by phone, or follow its Instagram and Facebook pages for current models and terms. Because each plan is published with clear deposit and monthly figures rather than a placeholder, it is straightforward to compare one model against another before visiting the shop.
heroText: Motor Zone publishes exact deposit and monthly payment terms for each car it sells, a level of transparency most dealerships in Cairo leave to a phone call.
address: Sayed Zakaria St, Sheraton, Morabaa El-Wozara, next to Al-Siddiq Mosque

aboutParagraphs: K.auto is a long-established car showroom run by Mahmoud Kosba, carrying marques that include Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, BMW, Audi, Lamborghini and Toyota. Recent cars on the floor have included a BMW X5 M60i and a Toyota Land Cruiser VXR.

The showroom operates from two addresses: Waslet Dahshour, beside Cairo University at Jumeirah Plaza Walk, and a second location at Beverly Hills, Gate 8 and 9, Mall 23. Cars are displayed on a circular dais under a domed ceiling, with a light running the rim of the floor, rather than parked in a conventional row.

Buyers can reach the showroom by phone at either address, or follow its Instagram and Facebook pages to see what is currently on the dais. The BMW X5 recently on the floor was listed with a detailed specification covering mileage, exterior and interior colour, engine and power output, supplied through the local agency.
heroText: Two showroom addresses, at Waslet Dahshour beside Cairo University and at Beverly Hills in Sheikh Zayed, put K.auto's roster of marques within easy reach.
address: Waslet Dahshour, beside Cairo University, Jumeirah Plaza Walk; Beverly Hills Gate 8, 9, Mall 23

aboutParagraphs: Auto Hub is a car dealership in Heliopolis selling brand-new and pre-owned vehicles, with stock spanning marques including Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, SEAT, Skoda, MG and Renault. German saloons on the lot are often labelled by their factory chassis code, such as W205 or G30, the same shorthand a workshop or owner would use rather than a sales floor.

The dealership is at 64 Nehru Street, off Al Sebaq Street, behind Merryland Park in Heliopolis, Cairo. Cars are typically photographed from multiple angles before being listed, giving buyers a clear view of each one ahead of a visit.

Buyers can reach the dealership by phone or email, or follow its Instagram and Facebook pages to see current stock and what has already sold. Instalment financing is advertised across the range, appearing consistently throughout the dealership's posts.
heroText: Auto Hub keeps its full sales history visible, marking each car sold rather than removing the listing, so buyers can see exactly what has moved through the door.
address: 64 Nehru St, off Al Sebaq St, behind Merryland Park, Heliopolis, Cairo

tagline: Fastest Growing Automotive Lending Centre in Egypt
aboutParagraphs: Teacher Motors is an automotive lending centre and dealership based on the Cairo-Alexandria Desert Road in Sheikh Zayed, Giza. Recent stock has ranged from a Rolls-Royce Cullinan and a Brabus 930 to a Jeep Grand Cherokee, a Mercedes-Benz GLE 450 and a Chevrolet Silverado, spanning everyday SUVs to some of the most exclusive names on the road.

The dealership fields a large bank of phone lines rather than a single number, so buyers calling in are rarely left waiting for someone to pick up. It also maintains its own website alongside active Instagram and Facebook pages, giving buyers several ways to check current stock before calling.

Instalment financing is available on many of the cars they carry, though not all: several listings, including the Brabus 930 and the Tesla Model X Plaid, carry no finance line at all and are sold on published performance figures instead, such as power, torque and acceleration. Buyers can reach Teacher Motors by phone, email or through its Instagram and Facebook pages to see what is currently in stock.
heroText: From Rolls-Royce and Brabus to Porsche and Tesla, Teacher Motors carries an unusually wide span of new and used vehicles, with instalment financing available on many of them.
address: Cairo–Alexandria Desert Road, Sheikh Zayed, Giza

aboutParagraphs: Melegy Auto is a car dealership selling used and nearly-new vehicles, with recent stock including a SEAT Ibiza, a Peugeot 508, a Fiat 500X, a Nissan Qashqai and a Mercedes-Benz C180, among others.

The dealership operates two showrooms: one in Nasr City, on Mehwar El Shaheed, and a second in Ismailia, at Fox Square, Ard El Gam3iyat. Both branches keep the same hours, open six days a week from midday until 1am.

Every available car is listed against the same set of details: year, trim, whether the paintwork is entirely factory-original, mileage, service history and licence status, with a full equipment list included. Each listing closes with the same three phone numbers and working hours, and buyers can reach either branch by phone or through the dealership's Instagram and Facebook pages.
heroText: Every available car at Melegy Auto is listed against the same fixed checklist, so buyers can compare condition and history in the same terms from one listing to the next.
address: Nasr City, Mehwar El Shaheed; Fox Square, Ard El Gam3iyat

aboutParagraphs: Vroom Automotive is a car showroom in Fifth Settlement, New Cairo, carrying a wide range of marques from exotic sports cars to everyday family models. Recent stock has included a Lamborghini Urus, a Ferrari 12Cilindri, a Mercedes-Benz CLA 180, a Rox 01, a Cadillac Escalade and a Skoda Kodiaq.

The showroom is at Unit G06, Plot 128, on 70th Street inside Bank Center, Fifth Settlement, New Cairo. Its display floor is set against a terracotta timber wall and a faceted marble panel, a backdrop that stays constant behind every car shown there.

Buyers can reach Vroom Automotive by phone, or follow the dealership on Instagram and Facebook to see current stock before visiting. The showroom's location is also listed on Google Maps for those planning a visit in person.
heroText: Every car on Vroom Automotive's floor, from a Lamborghini Urus to a Skoda Kodiaq, is presented against the same showroom wall, making the range easy to compare one car to the next.
address: Unit G06, Plot 128, 70th Street, Bank Center, Fifth Settlement, New Cairo

aboutParagraphs: Goda Motors is a car showroom in Cairo carrying premium marques including Mercedes-AMG, Mercedes-Benz and BMW. Recent stock has included a Mercedes-AMG SL 55, a Mercedes-Benz E180 in both Avantgarde and Exclusive trim, and a BMW X5 M40i.
Every car in the showroom is photographed in the same studio bay, lit by a single suspended ring light hanging above the car, a consistent setting that carries through every listing published.

Each listing opens with the dealership's own line about the car before settling into details such as mileage, trim, supply and whether the paintwork is factory-original. Buyers can reach Goda Motors by phone, or follow the dealership on Instagram and Facebook to see what's currently on the floor.
heroText: Goda Motors publishes an unhurried opening line before the numbers on every listing, then follows it with details such as mileage, trim, condition and factory paint.
address: Cairo, Egypt

aboutParagraphs: El Togary Auto is a car showroom in Nasr City, Cairo, carrying a broad range of marques from exotic sports cars to family SUVs. Recent stock has included a Mercedes-Benz C180, a Jaguar F-Type, a Porsche 718 Cayman, a Ferrari Roma, a Range Rover Evoque, a Peugeot 408, a Porsche Cayenne, a Volvo XC90 and Skoda's Superb and Kodiaq models.

Unlike a forecourt or a standalone building, the showroom operates from a retail unit inside City Stars Mall, Nasr City, putting its cars alongside the mall's other stores. Buyers can reach the showroom directly by phone, or through its listing on Google Maps.

Alongside its showroom stock, El Togary Auto also offers its Skoda models on instalment terms, with free administrative fees, no mandatory insurance and a free first-year licence included as part of the plan. Buyers can follow the dealership on Instagram and Facebook to see current offerings.
heroText: El Togary Auto pairs exotic marques like Ferrari and Porsche with instalment-plan Skoda models, all sold from the same showroom inside City Stars Mall.
address: Inside City Stars Mall, Nasr City, Cairo

aboutParagraphs: Moataz El Hawi Auto is a car dealership in Nasr City's Ninth District, on the Shinzo Abe Axis opposite Al-Masrawy Mosque, carrying marques including Mercedes-Benz, Jeep, Jaguar and BMW. Recent stock has included a Mercedes-Benz G500, a Jeep Grand Cherokee Limited, a Jaguar F-Type P300 and a BMW 320 M-Sport.

Every car on the forecourt is photographed in the same spot outside the showroom: a navy fascia bearing the dealership's name, a steel monogram mounted on the canopy above it, and a pair of fluted columns painted signal red on either side of the doorway.

Beyond the marques currently in view, the dealership has also dealt in MG, Fiat, Honda, Hyundai, Seat and Skoda, among others. Buyers can reach Moataz El Hawi Auto by phone, or follow the dealership on Instagram and Facebook to see what's currently on the forecourt.
heroText: Moataz El Hawi Auto's Nasr City forecourt carries performance and luxury picks, from a Mercedes-Benz G500 fitted with three differential locks for off-road use to a Jeep Grand Cherokee finished with an SRT kit, alongside Jaguar and BMW options.
address: Nasr City, Ninth District, Shinzo Abe Axis, opposite Al-Masrawy Mosque

aboutParagraphs: Al Mounir Motors is a car showroom in Sheikh Zayed, Giza, carrying premium marques including BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Range Rover. Recent stock has included a BMW X5 M40i, a Mercedes-AMG G63, a BMW Z4 Roadster, a Range Rover Evoque, a Mercedes-Benz V300 VIP, a Mercedes-Benz C180 and a Mercedes-Benz GLS 580 4MATIC.

The showroom operates two branches, a Zayed branch and a Fisal branch, with its Sheikh Zayed canopy carrying a herringbone chevron band that matches the dealership's own gold wordmark. The same showroom wall, visible in the background of one of the dealership's own posters, also carries branding for other marques, including Land Rover, Jeep, Audi and Volvo.

Buyers can reach Al Mounir Motors directly through WhatsApp, or by phone, and can follow the dealership on Instagram to see current stock. The showroom's location is also listed on Google Maps for those visiting Sheikh Zayed in person.
heroText: Al Mounir Motors' showroom canopy carries the same gold herringbone band as its own branding, with WhatsApp kept as the direct line to the floor.
address: Sheikh Zayed, Giza

aboutParagraphs: Gravity Auto is a car showroom in Sheikh Zayed, Giza, carrying brand-new and newly imported cars from marques including BYD, Volvo, BMW and Mercedes-Benz. Recent stock has included a BYD Sealion 06, a Volvo XC60, a BMW 235 Gran Coupe and a Mercedes-Benz C180 AMG Line.
The showroom is at Chill Out, Waslet Dahshour, opposite the Zayed 3 entrance in Sheikh Zayed, marked by a backlit Gravity Auto sign on the forecourt.

Most cars are listed with details such as motor size, power output and mileage, though their one electric car, the BYD Sealion 06, is listed with range instead. Buyers can reach Gravity Auto by phone, or follow the dealership on Instagram and Facebook to see current stock.
heroText: Gravity Auto's Sheikh Zayed forecourt pairs an all-electric BYD Sealion 06 with performance picks from Volvo, BMW and Mercedes-Benz, each a current-generation model recently brought into stock.
address: Chill Out, Waslet Dahshour, opposite the Zayed 3 entrance, Sheikh Zayed

aboutParagraphs: Trust Motors is a used car dealership in Ibrahimiya, Alexandria, dealing in the sale, purchase and consignment trade-in of cars. Recent stock has included a Suzuki Ciaz and a Kia Sportage, both listed as fully factory-original and agency-serviced.

The shop sits on a residential street in Ibrahimiya, directly across from the Fathallah supermarket's Riviera branch. Its shopfront sign reads Trust Motors, alongside a circular seal marking the dealership as Trust Motors, Alexandria.
Buyers can reach the dealership through Eng. Essam or Eng. Mohamed by phone, or through the shop's own landline. The dealership sums up its approach in its own line: your trust, our priority.
heroText: Trust Motors' current stock in Ibrahimiya includes a Suzuki Ciaz finished in the top trim Suzuki markets as its fingerprint keyless entry, alongside a Kia Sportage listed as fully factory-original and agency-serviced.
address: Ibrahimiya, opposite Fathallah Riviera, Alexandria

aboutText: Macan Automotive is a showroom on El Nozha Street in Nasr City, presenting its cars in a recessed portal with walnut piers, a red-lit fluted lintel and an amber sign. The floor carries marques including BYD, Range Rover and Mercedes-Benz.
address: 39 Rabia al-Adawiyya Buildings, El Nozha Street, Nasr City, Cairo

aboutText: Drive In Motors is a showroom in Nasr City, next to El Serag Mall, carrying Jetour, Kaiyi and Changan. Trade-ins are accepted against a new car.
address: 6 Negaty Serag Street, Nasr City, next to El Serag Mall, Cairo

aboutText: Exotica Automotive is a luxury and exotics dealership at ChillOut AUC, South Teseen, New Cairo, carrying marques including GMC, BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Range Rover, with a detailed specification published for every car.

gallery.caption: Range Rover Vogue P530 Long Wheelbase

address: ChillOut AUC – South Teseen, New Cairo

aboutText: Body Car, run by Ahmed Mostafa, is a showroom in El Basatin, Cairo, trading in new and used vehicles. Its showroom floor carries Mercedes-Benz models alongside a range of Korean and Chinese marques, with instalment financing available.
